covered_dimensions.description: No write path for audit exists (store exposes only AddAudit/ListAudit/CountAudit). Operator/viewer PUT/POST/DELETE /api/audit and DELETE /api/audit/{id} leave data intact: sampled record present and byte-identical afterwards, no record missing.
Audit page is read-only for operator and admin: no row buttons, no checkboxes, no edit/delete controls

remaining_or_limitations: DEF-AUDIT-METHOD-200 (low): handleAudit has no HTTP method switch, so POST/PUT/DELETE /api/audit return 200 with the audit list instead of 405. No mutation occurs, but the success-shaped response is misleading API semantics.
Audit is readable by all authenticated roles (HasPermission read); the assertion is about modify/delete, which is impossible.

canonical_before.expected: 登录、创建/修改/删除 Script、Task、Schedule、Artifact、Application（按用户角色权限验证）。

covered_dimensions.description: administrator / operator / viewer all log in through the Web UI; /api/me returns the expected Username/Role/UserID

Admin create/delete through the real UI for Script, Task, Schedule, Artifact, Application; modify through the UI for Script (r1->r2), Task (r1->r2), Schedule (r1->r2), Application (r1->r2). Artifact upload size/sha256 match local file.

Operator/Viewer read all five collections (200) but every create/update/delete returns 403; task run discriminates operator (canRun -> 400 'no target nodes') from viewer (403). UI hides create/upload/edit/delete controls for both; operator keeps the run control.
All five collections are byte-identical before/after the denied operator+viewer write attempts

remaining_or_limitations: The isolated instance has no enrolled agents, so Task/Schedule creation used a label target in the real UI form and 'run' cannot produce a real execution (ends with 'no target nodes').
Artifact has no update API by design; artifact modify is not applicable.
The whole instance (and all created users/resources) was destroyed after the batch.
